records.title: SSIT: A spatial–spectral interactive transformer for hyperspectral image denoising
records.abstractSummary: SSIT combines spatial permuted self-attention, spectral compression attention, interactive spatial–spectral fusion and a spectral-split feed-forward network; abstract reports synthetic and real noisy HSI experiments.

records.title: Adversarial Dilated Large-Kernel Attention Networks for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractSummary: ADLKAN combines cooperative spectral–spatial large-kernel attention with a multiscale conditional domain discriminator and adversarial training; abstract reports five public HSI datasets.

records.title: HSLiNets: Evaluating Band Ordering Strategies in Hyperspectral and LiDAR Fusion
records.abstractSummary: HSLiNets studies band-order effects in HSI–LiDAR fusion and adaptively fuses features from multiple spectral sequences; abstract reports Houston 2013 and Trento experiments.

records.title: Language-Enhanced Dual-Level Contrastive Learning Network for Open-Set Hyperspectral Image Classification
records.abstractLevel: public abstract mirror with IEEE metadata link
records.abstractSummary: LDCLNet uses language prior supervision, instance- and manifold-level visual–language contrastive learning, and distance-refined unknown-class discovery; abstract reports three public HSI datasets.
